pages.text: Blood moons fill the land with monsters and won't let you sleep. Stay in.$(br2)$(l)Weeping Angels$(): don't look away. $(l)The Man From The Fog$(): run, and don't stop. $(l)Something below$() in the caves follows quietly.$(br2)And if someone knocks at your door at night: $(l)do not answer the door.$()$(br2)Voice chat is proximity based. Screaming carries. $(o)Praise the sun!$()
